sources.title: Lure TTS - a Hugging Face Space by smirki
sources.snippet: Lure Expressive voice cloning in 0.6B parameters. It sighs, gasps, breaks and whispers where you tell it to. Pick a voice, write a line, and drop sounds inline, like (sigh) or (sharp inhale), right where they should happen. Add a short acting note to shape the delivery. Lure Turbo is the same voice with a faster decoding head. English only · research preview · Lure · Lure Turbo · lure-tts ...

sources.title: Best Text-to-Speech TTS Models in 2026: A Benchmark-Based Comparison
sources.snippet: Text-to-speech TTS moved fast over the past year. The line between synthetic and human speech narrowed. Latency dropped below 100 milliseconds for some real-time systems. Emotional control became a standard feature rather than a research demo. This guide reviews the models that really matter in 2026. It is written for AI professionals choosing a model for production.
